policy: These adapters are supplemental to integrations/vibe/manifest.json. Planning is allowed without execution. Cloning or running third-party code requires an exact pin and explicit approval.

integrations.name: ComposioHQ Awesome Claude Skills
integrations.notes: Do not treat the 1000+ listed skills as equally trusted. Pin the repository, inspect the selected skill and any linked upstream source, then adopt only reviewed directories. Connected-app actions and API keys require separate explicit authorization.

integrations.name: Microsoft Playwright MCP
integrations.notes: Prefer MCP when persistent browser state and rich introspection justify the context cost. For high-throughput coding-agent workflows, compare against Playwright CLI+Skills or Agent Browser before selecting it.
